assessment.product: Heartbeat AI: software that connects and optimizes solar panels, batteries, heat pumps, and EV chargers in customer homes, operating roughly 1 GW of shiftable capacity (targeting 20 GW by 2030) as one of Europe's largest residential virtual power plants, sold alongside the company's own hardware installation services.
